label: Welt Ticket Pocket
description: The welt ticket pocket is a miniature version of the breast pocket's welt treatment: a single strip of cloth sits below a neat horizontal slit, creating a defined mouth without the covering of a flap. It is slightly more visible than the jetted version and has a warm, traditional English character that suits tweed and flannel suits particularly well. The welt stands proud of the opening, giving the pocket a little more definition and visual weight than the fully flush jetted option.
